name: Max Hasler
headline: Co-Founder KONUX | Operator | Angel Investor
summary:
👋 I'm Max, Co-Founder of KONUX and Angel Investor.

🚅 At KONUX, we're revolutionizing the railway industry for a sustainable future through AI and IoT. Driven by innovation, we established KONUX to enhance operations and enable smart, data-driven decisions. As COO, I led key areas including finance, legal, HR, and operations, all focused on ensuring growth for 10 years.

🇺🇦 I also contribute to humanitarian efforts by supporting Ukraine’s fight for sovereignty. Through Help99, we provide specialized vehicles, drones, and equipment to strengthen logistics and front-line operations. This work is about making a tangible difference where it’s needed most.

🌐 Beyond KONUX, I am passionate about strengthening the startup ecosystem in Germany and across Europe. We need to take a more active role in shaping a positive technological future. I am also a long-time practitioner and competitor in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

WEF Technology Pioneer #Sustainability #AI #IoT
company.description:
KONUX is a leading German AI scale-up, transforming railway operations for a sustainable future. We combine Machine Learning and industrial IoT to make railway the mobility choice of tomorrow by increasing capacity, reliability, and cost-efficiency. 

Since its founding in 2014, KONUX has expanded to numerous countries in Europe and Asia, and was selected by the World Economic Forum (WEF) as one of the world’s 30 most innovative start-ups and scale-ups worldwide.

Do you want to join our team and help us take IoT where it really makes a difference? Do you love to take ownership and go the extra mile to ensure our customers’ success? Are you ready to work in an environment that believes in open feedback, constant growth, and a strong team culture? KONUX might be the place for you! Check out konux.com/career or contact us at career@konux.com.
